body.text: The safety-significant NI buildings are the RXB, FHB, RAB, and NCB.
body.anchor: which includes the Reactor Building (RXB), Fuel Handling Building (FHB), Reactor Auxiliary Building (RAB), and Nuclear Island Control Building (NCB)

body.text: The RXB superstructure is classified NST.
